title: Shinonome Ena — Featuring KUROMI〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Morning.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Good morning, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ena, you actually woke up on time? Oh, I get it! You had your Li'l Bro wake you, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I woke up on my own thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Besides, I've got everyone's tickets, so I had to be on time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You said you got the tickets for the satellite Puroland from Momoi?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. She said, “They gave me these 'cos I'll be appearing in an event. You want 'em?”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it's still amazing though. I heard they were standing in for someone, but sharing the stage with My Melody is a whole other level!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe, well for idols as talented as Airi and the others it's only natural. They're performing today too, so we definitely need to go watch.
Satellite Puroland

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's bigger than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. Apparently there's a number of attractions from the actual Sanrio Puroland we can experience here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Some of the fine details of the interior look a bit different, but the atmosphere and the attractions seem fairly close to the original.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow...
Ooh! There's a boat attraction! Let's ride that one!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hang on a sec! Are we gonna get soaked on that thing?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The sign doesn't mention anything about that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So it's fine then! Come on, let's line up♪

rows.Speaker: Puroland Staff Member
rows.Line: Welcome to the Sanrio Character Boat Ride! The wait time is currently 30 minutes.

rows.Speaker: Puroland Staff Member
rows.Line: If you would like, please feel free to enjoy our app while you wait.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Satellite Park Exclusive Free Coloring App”?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Help Hello Kitty, My Melody and their Puroland friends look cute by coloring in these pictures!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That looks fun! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, we do have 30 minutes we need to kill anyway. Okay, so I just scan this code, right?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think I'll try it out as well. What about you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I will too.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmmm, now who should I color? They're all so cute.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How 'bout Kuromi? You both kind of have the same vibe.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Look, if you tap on the top right of the page you have open, you can see that character's profile.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really? Okay, where is...
Oh! Here's Kuromi.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Kuromi is the self-proclaimed rival of My Melody. Although she may look tough, she is actually very girly and is attracted to good-looking guys!”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, hang on. What makes you think she and I are alike?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Just a feeling?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I mean, if I had to pinpoint it...
You're a little prickly on the outside, but you're actually really considerate and care a lot about your friends. Or something like that?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Who do you think you're calling prickly?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh-oh, did I strike a nerve?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oww! Kanade, Mafuyu, you saw that, right?! She hit me!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmhmhm♪ Lalala♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The eyelashes seem pretty integral to the design of her eyes. And then I want the mouth to look confident...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ugh, I wish I could use layers! And I wish the pen were finer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ah! I used the fill tool by mistake. Uh, how do I make it go back?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: The Undo button in the lower left corner.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, my finger was covering it. Thanks, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Done.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh that was fast! Lemme see lemme see!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That one's...
Cogimyun? You only colored her hair accessories.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's because the rest of her is white.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, sure, but...
What about the background, or adding some items or other accessories? There's so much space for you to draw things in.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, I thought there seemed like a lot of white space. That must be what they want you to use it for.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just colored inside the lines...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, the one you're coloring is so cute, Kanade! Is that a blanket on its head?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I think so. His name is...
Moppu.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I see! The soft colors you used on the polka-dot blanket look great.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You think so? Maybe because I tried to pick colors similar to the original.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, check mine out♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ta-daaa! Say hello to Bonbonribbon♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's a lot of ribbons.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's what makes it cute! Here, look! I added lace to the ribbon on her head♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?! That wasn't part of it originally? Wait, did you use some effect to draw that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Bingo♪ It's part of the app, so I tried it out. Makes it look extra fancy and cute, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. Nice job.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How is yours coming, Ena? You were coloring Kuromi, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I'm mostly finished, but...
I figure I might as well draw in a little something extra.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here. This is what I've got so far.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Amazing... There are shadows and shading.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Whoa! That is way beyond coloring book level. Can't believe you made that on an app with such simple features.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That reminds me. She was also complaining about the lack of a layering feature and the thickness of the pen in the middle of it.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You didn't have to put it like that. All I said was it'd be nice if they had it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think it looks great, but you're still going to work on it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. We still have to wait in line for a bit longer anyway.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Maybe I'll draw a background, and make it into a little scene. Oh, I should give her some clothes too!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh, clothes would be great! I can help with the design if you want♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Really? Great, let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okie dokie!
Ooh! So how about something that fits with Kuromi's motif? Like her favorite food or something!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hm? I think her favorite food was...
Pickled scallions?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Really? That seems a bit plain for her.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think it's great. I love that she's unapologetically herself.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's good that she likes what she likes, but as far as motifs go, I mean it's gotta be the skull, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come on, everyone does that! Pickled scallions are more challenging♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Challenging, or absurd?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, maybe not as the main motif...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I think adding some here and there as accents could work, probably...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Interesting.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go with that♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Just you wait, Kuromi! Ena's gonna make you some super cute clothes!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Quit playing around...
Come on, gimme some real ideas to work with.
